instruction: Candid documentary medium close-up of an indoor wedding venue with drapes. On the right, the older woman in a floral dress (R1) has her back fully turned to the camera as she embraces the young bride in a red dress (R2) on the left. The young bride looks emotional and sad, gazing over the older woman's shoulder while holding her bouquet. Warm, soft indoor lighting highlights the vibrant red and dark floral palette of their garments.
